title: 9 Days & 8 Nights Yoga Retreat in Uluwatu Bali
metaTitle: 9 Days Yoga Retreat in Uluwatu Bali
metaDescription: Experience a life-changing 9-Day Yoga & Meditation Retreat in Uluwatu, Bali. Rejuvenate your body and mind with yoga, healing, and relaxation by the sea.
summary: A 9 days & 8 nights yoga retreat in Uluwatu with daily pranayama & meditation, Hatha Vinyasa yoga, healing sessions and 8 complimentary Balinese massages.
intro: Nestled in the serene coastal beauty of Uluwatu, our retreat center provides the perfect blend of comfort and tranquility. Enjoy private rooms designed for relaxation, two outdoor swimming pools surrounded by tropical gardens, and peaceful open spaces where you can meditate, read, or simply bask in the golden sunlight.

Each day begins with energizing yoga sessions followed by guided meditation, pranayama, and Hatha Vinyasa flow practices led by our experienced and compassionate teachers. Our instructors blend ancient yogic wisdom with modern techniques to help you detoxify the body, calm the mind, and awaken inner awareness — regardless of your age or level of experience.

Beyond yoga, you’ll experience a variety of healing therapies, including Balinese massages and self-improvement workshops. Between sessions, explore the magic of Uluwatu — its breathtaking beaches, sacred temples perched on cliffs, and vibrant local culture.

arrival: The best and most convenient way to travel to Bali Yoga School is to take a flight to Denpasar Bali airport. Denpasar Bali airport is merely 38 km away from our school. As soon as you book your flight, forward us your flight details and we will send our driver to meet you from Denpasar Bali airport and drive to the school.

policies.title: Class timings
items: The Management team holds the right to change the timings of the classes if it is needed.

policies.title: Booking Process
items: In order to book for retreat kindly deposit the Advance booking amount of 150 USD. Balance should be paid on arrival either by card, cash or Online transfer. An official confirmation letter concerning your program will be sent to you shortly after successful advance booking fee.

policies.title: Refund Policy
items: Booking deposit is refundable only when the customer cancels the course more than 15 days before the course starting date. The booking deposit will be refunded after deducting the amount of 10% from the deposit as the service charge + bank charge + the government tax. The refund will be initiated within 7 working days upon the request. If you cancel the course within 15 days from the course starting date, the deposit is not refundable. In this case, we accept date rescheduling.
If you cancel the course after joining, we accept the cancellation but the course fees will not be refunded with the cancellation.
